action.mutates: holds /var/lib/dpkg/lock-frontend open (flock) for 150 s in a background shell, which then writes its release time to /run/p8test-bootrun/bounded-released; records the start time in /run/p8test-bootrun/bounded-start and starts puppet_boot_run.service (one agent run against the lab master, writing the agent's state under /opt/puppetlabs/puppet/cache and the script's log /tmp/puppet_boot_run.log), copied to /run/p8test-bootrun/bounded.log

outcomes.outcome: the script and the unit are installed, and the unit is enabled for multi-user.target (not kept running)
started while another agent run holds the lockfile, the unit skips without competing and succeeds
started as the boot does while dpkg's lock is held, the unit waits for the lock, then makes one agent run and succeeds
the lock wait is bounded, so a lock held past 120 s delays the agent run by no more than that
an agent run longer than 900 s is cut off and the boot still finishes (the unit exits 0)

uncovered.why: the limit is longer than a check's action may run, and the lab's agent runs finish in seconds
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a check action longer than 900 s, or a held agent run, inside a phase3 run
uncovered.evidence: phase3.py accepts a mutating check's timeout of 1-600 s; the script's PUPPET_TIMEOUT is 900 (puppet_boot_run.sh:6)

outcomes.outcome: the unit runs during a real boot, after the network is up enough for the agent to reach the master

uncovered.why: a run does not reboot the class's node; the unit is started by hand instead
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a reboot of the class's node inside a phase3 run
uncovered.evidence: phase3.py has no reboot step: a run reverts, applies, probes, and at most runs the node's agent (node_agent)
